_comment: DRAFT for team review. Closed incidents on SKID-A before this run, written by Atelic so the Incidents page shows a believable history. Fictional events and people. Each one ties to an existing record in maintenance/history.json on purpose. No emission rates are recorded for them (none were measured). status 'sample' -> Simulated (hidden on screen, kept in exports).

incidents.summary: CAM-03 flagged a moving thermal pattern near PSV-102. The reviewer matched it to hot exhaust from a parked service truck; a handheld check read background methane.

decision.reason: Hot exhaust from a service truck; handheld detector read background.

timeline.event: Handheld check near PSV-102: background methane
Dismissed as false alarm by Rashid Haddad

incidents.summary: CAM-01 showed a small plume at the vent. The field crew confirmed a release at the vent-base flange and the gasket was replaced.

timeline.event: Field crew confirmed a release at the vent-base flange
Work order WO-2025-0412 approved by Rashid Haddad
Gasket replaced; retest clean; incident closed

incidents.summary: Intermittent plume-like signal near XV-104 on CAM-01. The stem packing was adjusted as a precaution; the retest found no leak.

timeline.event: Inspection work order approved by Sara Al-Mansoori
Packing adjusted; retest found no leak; incident closed
